changes_that_matter.issue: Original proposal mixed whole-position proceeds and per-unit entry denominator
changes_that_matter.required_lock: Delta = [Q*Poff - feeoff - (Q*Pon - feeon)] / [Q*Pentry + buyfee]. Equivalent proportional-fee unit formula .999*(Poff-Pon)/(Pentry*1.001), using one consistent price unit and actual original Q. Entry fee cancels only in numerator, remains in capital denominator.
changes_that_matter.decision_effect: Avoids weighting high-capital later cycles more heavily while calling cycles equal-weight. Root accepted before labels.

changes_that_matter.issue: Per-cycle OFF label would not evaluate a state recomputed every following day
changes_that_matter.required_lock: At the first eligible actual SHOCK D evaluate one state once. A hold decision latches an independent shock_disable flag until that actual cycle closes; raw SHOCK remains observed and all cost/support/grace/deadline/pending exits remain active. An exit decision follows original ON. Do not reuse old TREND_CYCLE support-protection latch.
changes_that_matter.decision_effect: Aligns component outcome with any later proposed policy action. A future full policy still requires its own causal entry/completion history and actual account; this component is not that account.

They are the same clock (remaining=9-age), not independent controls. Retain all unsupported layers and compare states within common remaining layers before calling a pooled difference state discrimination.
changes_that_matter.decision_effect: A pooled advantage with no within-clock overlap stays unresolved. Do not stratify by future realized alternative holding duration, change bins, or introduce a minimum-count/CI rejection gate.

changes_that_matter.decision_effect: Negative or contrary-direction results remain negative for these predeclared mechanisms; do not flip a sign and present the result as pre-specified confirmation.

S2.direction: Known dominance FALSE (r1<=r4) supports hold; known dominanceTRUE follows original exit. Equality belongs to the predeclared hold side.

OFF disables SHOCK only for the remainder of this one cycle. Preserve actual publicresolver, future cost/support/GRACE/H10/inherited pending and blockedSELL continuation. No reset of deadline or one-day fabricated rebuy.

Stop at that alternative actual liquidation; no reentry, cash compounding, further loss-pause account or annual funded simulation. Later actual source-account trades are not imported into the local branch.

If no alternative SELL by original2026-10-15, keep censored Delta null and include the row; do not use postcutoff data or force liquidation. Any cutoff mark must be separately named and cannot replace closed-cycle Delta.
Strict positive/zero/negative Delta from consistent arithmetic; identical proceeds produce true zero. No outcome-driven epsilon, clipping or maturity drop.
